sources.title: Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-rays (CNN - DenseNet121)
sources.snippet: This project provides a sophisticated medical AI solution for the automated detection of Pneumonia from chest X-ray images. Utilizing the DenseNet121 architecture, known for its dense connectivity and efficient feature propagation, the model assists healthcare professionals by accurately classifying scans into "Normal" or "Pneumonia" categories.

sources.snippet: Developed an AI-based Pneumonia Detection system using Deep Learning and DenseNet121 transfer learning to classify chest X-ray images as Normal or Pneumonia. Applied data augmentation and fine-tuning to improve model performance.
